classification: Actual native Godot mage fixtures using finite acquisition/merge/discard APIs, player persistence disabled. These are controlled fixtures, not external playtests.
runtime: Windows Godot 4.7.2 .NET / OpenGL compatibility / NVIDIA RTX 3070 Laptop GPU
conversion: Actual Movie Maker frames cropped at original size, per-frame 255-color GIF quantization and transparent unchanged-pixel deltas. Both 144-frame composites independently decoded and compared to quantized native frames (39,840,768 pixels each). GIFs omit HUD and board, and fixed recording FPS is not a gameplay performance measurement.

profiles.moth: 1440x960 frost+gale finite build, with ward, versus mirror moth; selected native frames and derived report.
profiles.golem: 1440x960 steam+vortex finite build after two legal starter discards, with ward, versus thorn golem; selected native frames and derived report.
profiles.small: 1280x800 moth fixture, selected frames and derived report.
profiles.large: 1920x1080 golem fixture, selected frames and derived report.
profiles.no_ward: Same moth build with normal discard of UID4 ward; no shield effect, selected frames and derived report.
profiles.before_icon_region_fix: Intermediate moth preparation with equal-half icon crop; lower-row pixels could enter the upper icons, not current UI.
profiles.tests: Complete actual GPU and rule test report; player save fingerprints checked. Separate synthetic lethal fixture is not gameplay footage.
profiles.gif_checks: Independent decompression and pixel-composition checks for the two GIFs.
